name: Grave-Prison of Zakajz
summary: The Grave-Prison of Zakajz is an ancient, partially collapsed subterranean cavern hidden deep beneath the western reaches of Tirisfal Glades. It serves as the eternal resting place and seal for Zakajz the Corruptor, a monstrous C'Thrax defeated millennia ago by the titan keeper Tyr.

sections.title: The Slumbering Corruptor
sections.body: Buried far beneath the earth and connected to the Tomb of Tyr via the perilous passage known as the Darkwalk, this deep cavern holds the remains of Zakajz the Corruptor. Ages ago, the titan keeper Tyr sacrificed himself in a cataclysmic confrontation to defeat the C'Thrax and protect early humanity. Though vanquished, the immense aberration was sealed away in this shadowy vault to ensure its vile corruption would never seep into the surface world.

sections.title: A Sealed Nightmare
sections.body: The atmosphere of the prison is heavy with ancient malice and decay. While the world above attends to mortal wars, the cavern remains haunted by grotesque horrors, including faceless guardians, flesh spawns, and aberrant remnants loyal to the slumbering beast. Its hidden depths remain undisturbed by the kingdoms of Lordaeron, silent and deadly to any foolhardy enough to breach the ancient seals.

faq.q: What is the Grave-Prison of Zakajz?
faq.answer: It is a subterranean chamber buried deep beneath Tirisfal Glades where the titan keeper Tyr entombed the defeated C'Thrax monstrosity known as Zakajz the Corruptor thousands of years ago.

aliases: how to get to grave prison
faq.answer: It lies deep beneath the earth under the Tomb of Tyr in western Tirisfal Glades, accessible only through the shadowy subterranean path known as the Darkwalk.

Zakajz was a terrifying, towering C'Thrax servant of the Old Gods. In the ancient past, it hunted early mortals until the noble titan keeper Tyr battled the beast to the death, sacrificing himself to fell the creature.

faq.q: What lurks inside the cavern today?
faq.answer: The prison is infested with dark aberrations born of old shadows, including faceless corrupters, mindless flesh spawn, and horrifying monstrosities that guard the sealed remains.

angles.text: For knights of the holy order, this deep cavern represents the ultimate resting ground of the titan keeper Tyr's final sacrifice, a legendary act of selflessness from which the Silver Hand draws its very inspiration.
Priests studying the delicate balance of the cosmos recognize this desolate subterranean tomb as a monument to ancient shadow, where cosmic malevolence was put to rest by sacrificial grace.
